title: Feedback Curator skeleton + pattern extraction
description: Create the Feedback Curator agent that runs nightly batch: compares win cohort (top 20%) vs fail cohort (bottom 20%) from outcome labels, extracts structured patterns, and writes WikiEntry objects to the review queue. Implements bilateral wiki sync write path (agents write to review queue only, never to canonical).
sub_tasks: Create FeedbackCurator class with curate(outcomes) method
Implement pattern extraction logic (feature diff between cohorts)
Create ReviewQueue class for bilateral sync (write-only, no direct canonical)
Wire WikiEntry creation from extracted patterns
Unit tests for cohort splitting, pattern extraction, review queue isolation
